description: Předmětem VZ je provedení stavebních oprav a výměna oken na budovách B a D v areálu Generálního štábu AČR. Dílo bude provedeno dle zpracované dokumentace z 02/2025, kterou zpracovala společnost KOSTKA projekt s.r.o. pod zakázkovým číslem 2025-12. Dále je nutné při provádění díla dodržet závazné stanovisko vydané Odborem památkové péče MHMP (Č.j. MHMP 743886/2026, kde Národní památkový ústav vyžaduje mj. účast na kontrolních dnech. Dílo bude provedeno v kvalitě odpovídající platným ČSN, normám ISO, v souladu s platnými právními předpisy, dalšími správními rozhodnutími, vztahujícími se k této konkrétní stavbě. Podrobné vymezení předmětu plnění VZ je uvedeno v návrhu Smlouvy o dílo (dále jen „Smlouva“), který je přílohou č. 1 těchto ZP. Obchodní podmínky, včetně fakturačních a platebních podmínek, smluvních pokut a podmínek zániku Smlouvy jsou podrobně stanoveny v návrhu Smlouvy.

title: Neubau Kita Schwalbennest - Elektroarbeiten
description: Die Gemeinde Schönefeld beabsichtigt die Kita Schwalbennest, Schwalbenweg 8, Schönefeld komplett neu zu errichten. Hier handelt es sich um die Elektroarbeiten. Im Zuge des Neubaus der KITA Schwalbennest wird die Elektroinstallation mit den Kostengruppen 440 und 450 ausgeschrieben. Die elektrische Energieversorgung erfolgt über einem neuen Hausanschluss der E.DIS Netz GmbH. Der Eektroenergiebedarf wird über eine Wandlermessung erfasst. Der neu zu errichtende Gebäude-Hauptverteiler(NSHV) versorgt dabei in dem zweigeschossigen Gebäude jeweils zwei Unterverteilungen pro Etage. Zur Senkung des Elektroenergiebedarfs ist eine PV-Anlage auf dem Flachdach vorgesehen. Im Gebäude ist eine Sicherheitsbeleuchtung der Flucht- und Rettungswege gemäß Brandschutzkonzept vorzusehen. Die Sicherheitsbeleuchtungsanlage wird gemäß DIN VDE 0108-100 und DIN EN 1838 ausgeführt. Die Sicherheitsbeleuchtung wird dabei über eine Einzellbatterieanlage realisiert. Die Erdungsanlage wird gemäß DIN 18014 hergestellt. Eine baurechtlich geforderte Blitzschutzanlage wird gemäß der Blitzschutzklasse III nach DIN VDE 0185-305 errichtet.

title: Germany – Real estate services – Bayerischer Rundfunk (BR) Funkhausareal Südteil | Munich Media Hub (MMH)
description: Weiterentwicklung und Realisierung eines Medien-, Veranstaltungs-, Büro-, Studio- und Mobilitätscluster ----------------------------------------------------------- Gegenstand des Vorhabens ist die Weiterentwicklung des Südteils des Funkhausareals in München am Rundfunkplatz zu einem Medien-, Veranstaltungs-, Büro-, Studio- und Mobilitätscluster durch einen im Vergabeverfahren auszuwählenden Projektpartner. Der BR bleibt im Südteil Grundstückseigentümer und soll dort als Leitnutzer und Impulsgeber sichtbar bleiben. Er erfüllt damit auch die Anforderungen aus der Gemeinbedarfsbindung des Bebauungsplans Nr. 937 der Landeshauptstadt München, in dessen Umgriff die zu entwickelnden bzw. zu überplanenden Grundstücke liegen. Das Vorhaben umfasst – nach Durchführung der vorgesehenen und zur Realisierung des Vorhabens auch erforderlichen Realteilung der derzeit ungeteilten Flächen – mehrere Grundstücke im Südteil des Hochhausareals. Grundlage für die räumliche Einordnung ist der im „kleinen“ Datenraum bereitgestellte vorläufige Realteilungsplan. Die endgültige Grundstücks-, Erbbaurechts-, Dienstbarkeits- und Schnittstellenstruktur wird im weiteren Verfahren auf Grundlage der freigegebenen Plan- und Vertragsunterlagen konkretisiert. Die Vorhabenbeschreibung sieht die Bestellung zweier Erbbaurechte auf noch real zu teilenden Flächen vor. Der spätere Erbbauberechtigte soll das unternehmerische Risiko der mit den Erbbaurechten verknüpften Verpflichtungen zu genehmigungsfähiger Planung, Bau, Sanierung, Vermietung, Betrieb, Bewirtschaf-tung, Instandhaltung, Finanzierung und Schnittstellensteuerung im vertraglich festgelegten Umfang tragen. Das Verfahren umfasst drei Auftragsbestandteile: • Auftragsbestandteil 1: Veranstaltungsbereich („Erbbaurecht 1“). • Auftragsbestandteil 2: Hochhaus („Erbbaurecht 2“). • Auftragsbestandteil 3: Tiefgarage (eigentums- bzw. erbbaurechtsübergreifend). --- Gegenstand des geplanten wettbewerblichen Dialogs ist keine isolierte Bau- oder Sanierungsleistung, sondern die vertragliche Strukturierung, Entwicklung, Finanzierung, bauliche Realisierung, Vermietung, Bewirtschaftung und Instandhaltung von drei eng miteinander verzahnten Teilprojekten. Der BR kann im Dialog auch Finanzierungsvarianten, Finanzierungsunterstützungen oder eine eigene Finanzierungskomponente prüfen, soweit dies vergaberechtlich zulässig, wirtschaftlich vorteilhaft und mit dem angestrebten Gesamtsystem vereinbar ist. Eine Finanzierungszusage des BR wird jedoch ausdrücklich nicht erteilt. ------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Die nähere Beschreibung der Maßnahme und die Bedingungen zur Teilnahme entnehmen Sie den Vergabeunterlagen, insbesondere den Dokumenten "BR_MMH_Vorhabenbeschreibung" und "BR_MMH_Bewerbungsbedingungen und Verfahrensbeschreibung". --- Darin ist auch die Aufwandsentschädigung für die Teilanahme an der Dialogphase umfassend geregelt.

title: Construction de la nouvelle gare routière
description:
Description générale


La gare routière d'Ettiswil constitue un pôle d'échanges régional important pour les transports publics. Elle sert de point de correspondance et relie les lignes de bus en provenance de Lucerne, Sursee, Willisau et Dagmersellen.


Cette gare routière se caractérise par sa situation au centre du village, sa connexion directe au réseau routier cantonal depuis quatre directions, l'exiguïté de l'espace disponible et une offre de bus adaptée aux différentes lignes avec une fréquence modérée (cadence à la demi-heure).


Afin de répondre aux exigences futures liées à ce rôle de pôle d'échanges régional, la construction d'une nouvelle gare routière est prévue. Ce projet vise à valoriser l'espace central du village sur le plan urbanistique et à mettre en œuvre les dispositions légales relatives à l'égalité pour les personnes handicapées.


Le projet de gare routière comprend essentiellement les éléments suivants :


Cinq quais d'arrêt (de A à E) pour bus articulés et trois quais d'embarquement.

Un espace central sur le quai 2 comprenant des emplacements pour vélos, des toilettes, des informations aux voyageurs, un distributeur de billets et des sièges.

Une couverture pour les quais 1 et 2 (le quai 3 n'est pas couvert).

Trois places de stationnement de courte durée (dépose-minute / « Kiss & Ride ») accessibles depuis la Willisauerstrasse (K 18), dont une aménagée pour les personnes en fauteuil roulant.

Un abri pour vélos situé à côté des places de stationnement pour véhicules individuels.

Une allée arborée le long de la Grosswangerstrasse et de la Willisauerstrasse.

L'aménagement du carrefour « Am Bächli » avec un nouveau cheminement piétonnier par l'arrière.

L'élargissement de la Grosswangerstrasse et la création d'un îlot central.

Le réaménagement des abords du bâtiment « Alte Schmitte », incluant la démolition des annexes sans intérêt patrimonial et une nouvelle disposition des deux bâtiments annexes conservés. Travaux de gros œuvre (génie civil et bâtiment) pour la réalisation de la nouvelle gare routière d'Ettiswil.


Génie civil

Les travaux de gros œuvre comprennent essentiellement les éléments suivants :


Démolition de bâtiments (bâtiment de la Poste, annexe « Schmitte », équipements existants)

Démolition/dépose de plantations, clôtures, murs, revêtements, bordures, regards, conduites, etc.

Travaux de réseaux (électricité, éclairage, communications)

Installations d'assainissement : conduites pour eaux usées et eaux pluviales, regards, dessableurs, avaloirs, caniveaux, bassin de rétention de 30 m³

Fosses de plantation

Fondations

Superstructure de voirie (couches de forme, bordures, revêtements, îlot piétonnier collé)

Revêtements en enrobé (2 et 3 couches), pavés autobloquants en béton, surfaces stabilisées, chaussées en béton (2 couches)

Bordures spécifiques pour arrêts de bus, incluant diverses pièces sur mesure (pierres naturelles spéciales)

Bâtiment


Génie civil / Bâtiment


Les travaux de gros œuvre comprennent les éléments principaux suivants :


grande marquise de quai avec 6 poteaux encastrés et fondations en puits (ou plots à réservation)

marquise de quai allongée avec 3 poteaux encastrés et fondations en puits

abri à vélos avec 1 poteau encastré et fondations en puits, 1 voile en béton

dalle de sol avec longrines hors gel et murets pour le bloc sanitaires situé sous la grande marquise

dalle de sol avec longrines hors gel et murets pour le garage double

dalle de sol avec longrines hors gel et murets pour le local de rangement (extension de l'ancienne forge)

mur en béton entre l'abri à vélos et le garage double

mur en béton entre le garage double et l'extension de la forge

mur de jardin courbe

1 semelle filante et diverses fondations isolées

Exigences pour le béton apparent :


Tous les éléments dépassant du revêtement de sol doivent être réalisés en béton apparent.


Sous-faces des marquises de quai : coffrage de type 4.1.4 (voir plans de l'ingénieur en structure – Hellerplan)

Faces frontales courbes en béton et mur de soutènement circulaire : coffrage de type 3.1.3 (planches verticales)

title: ZAB - Tiefgarage - Elektroinstallationen
description:
Neubau Tiefgarage (Sockelbau für spätere Phosphorrückgewinnungsanlage)

In der bestehenden Schlammverbrennungsanlage wird seit über 15 Jahren entwässerter und getrockneter Klärschlamm sowie Tiermehl aus der benachbarten Tiermehlfabrik verbrannt/mineralisiert. Die aus der Verbrennung/Mineralisierung anfallende Asche ist phosphorhaltig. Diese Asche soll künftig in der neu erstellten Phosphorrückgewinnungsanlage durch die Verfahrensschritte Lagerung>Säureaufschluss>Homogenisierung>Trocknung>Granulierung zu Einnähr- und Mehrnährstoffdünger verarbeitet werden. Diese Dünger werden künftig in Zusammenarbeit mit der Düngerindustrie in der Landwirtschaft vermarktet. Bisher importiert die Schweizer Landwirtschaft diesen Dünger.


Mit dem Neubau der Tiefgarage wird der Sockelbau für die spätere Phosphoranlage geschaffen. In der Tiefgarage befinden sich Parkplätze für die Mitarbeiter sowie für die Elektro-Sammelfahrzeuge und betriebliche Nebenräume.


Die Anfrage umfasst die kompletten Elektroinstallationen gemäss Ausschreibung.

title: Sanierung Bergackerstrasse / Schluecht, Cham
description:
Mit dem Projekt werden die Bergackerstrasse und der Abschnitt Schluecht in der Gemeinde Cham des Kanton Zugs saniert.

Die Bergackerstrasse wird im Abschnitt ab dem Flachsacker bis zur Schluecht beziehungsweise zum Schluechthof umfassend saniert. Der bestehende Strassenraum wird dabei instandgesetzt und den heutigen Anforderungen angepasst. Wo notwendig wird die Entwässerung angepasst.

Die WWZ Energie AG ersetzt abschnittsweise bestehende Trinkwasserhausanschlüsse. Zudem werden im Projektperimeter zwei neue Unterflurcontainerstandorte realisiert.

title: Regional framework agreement for firefighter protective clothing – Werdenberg
description:
Conclusion of a regional framework agreement with a supplier for the delivery of fire-resistant clothing, consisting of jackets and pants, including subsequent deliveries as well as repair and maintenance services.


The procurement is being conducted jointly on behalf of the Werdenberg Süd Fire Department Association and the fire departments of Grabs, Gams, and Sennwald. The Werdenberg Fire Department Association will handle the administrative implementation and coordination on behalf of the participating contracting authorities.


The estimated procurement volume comprises 340 sets, each consisting of one jacket and one pair of pants, as specified in the quantity sheet. The quantities are non-binding estimates and do not constitute a minimum purchase requirement. Orders will be placed independently by the individual contracting authorities as needed.


The base term is five years, with two extension options of two years each. The maximum contract term is nine years. The contract is expected to begin in the first quarter of 2027.


The technical requirements, availability of replacement parts, and repair and maintenance services are governed by the tender documents.

title: Netherlands – Repair and maintenance services – Calamiteitenwerkzaamheden rioolwaterpersleidingen
description: Waterschap Noorderzijlvest is voornemens een raamovereenkomst te sluiten met één opdrachtnemer voor het uitvoeren van calamiteitenwerkzaamheden aan rioolwaterpersleidingen binnen het beheergebied van het waterschap. De werkzaamheden worden op afroep uitgevoerd en hebben betrekking op onvoorziene storingen, defecten en beschadigingen die directe inzet vereisen om risico’s voor milieu, veiligheid en de continuïteit van de afvalwaterketen te beperken. De opdrachtnemer dient 24 uur per dag en 7 dagen per week beschikbaar te zijn voor het lokaliseren van schade, het uitvoeren van herstelwerkzaamheden en het treffen van tijdelijke maatregelen. Tot de opdracht behoren tevens alle benodigde nevenwerkzaamheden, waaronder verkeers- en veiligheidsmaatregelen, bronbemaling, grondwerkzaamheden, materiaalvoorziening en afvoer van vrijkomende materialen. Planmatig onderhoud, vervangingen en projectmatige werkzaamheden maken geen onderdeel uit van deze opdracht. De geraamde opdrachtwaarde bedraagt € 350.000 exclusief btw over de maximale looptijd van de raamovereenkomst. De maximale waarde van de raamovereenkomst bedraagt € 525.000 exclusief btw. De initiële contractduur bedraagt 24 maanden met een eenmalige verlengingsoptie van 24 maanden. Aan de genoemde waarde kunnen geen rechten worden ontleend, aangezien de omvang van de werkzaamheden afhankelijk is van het aantal en de aard van de voorkomende calamiteiten.

title: ADVANCE PROCUREMENT NOTICE - RECAPITALIZE ANTI ARMOUR RANGE (MDB)
description: Advance Procurement Notice Recapitalize Anti Armour Range (MODIFIED DESIGN-BUILD) 5 CDSB Gagetown, Oromocto, NB. (with Security Requirements) Purpose of this Advance Procurement Notice This is not a bid solicitation nor a request for proposals. In the context of the major investments announced by the Government and to foster a proactive partnership with industry, DCC is issuing this Advance Procurement Notice (APN) to inform design-builders of an upcoming contract opportunity at 5 CDSB Gagetown, Oromocto, NB. The purpose of this APN is to allow design-builders to assess their capacity and interest in participating, and to prepare adequately for the potential solicitation process, notably by initiating any necessary steps. This is a preliminary notice regarding a potential contract, which includes security requirements. The purpose of this APN is to allow interested design-builders to initiate, if required, the sponsorship process to obtain the necessary clearances or security clearances (if applicable). Please note that this project may include Indigenous businesses participation component in accordance with the Procurement Strategy for Indigenous Business (PSIB). Please note that there is no guarantee that this contract will proceed or that security clearances will be granted within the anticipated timelines or at all as part of the sponsorship process. Description of the Project and Services It is anticipated that the following solicitation will proceed as noted in the table below. This is conditional on the contract receiving approval to proceed from DND. Contract Number: HQ04022_86689 Title: Recapitalize Anti Armour Range Approximate Estimate: $109M Anticipated Posting: November 2026 Description: The proposed recapitalization work includes: Upgrade Firing Point 6 (FP6) to serve as a replacement for Firing Point 4 (FP4), ensuring continued Level 5/6 training capability during construction. The FP6 recapitalization includes four new 2 km long firing lanes, crossing lanes for target access, protective berms, fire base pads, unexploded ordnance (UXO) clearance, vegetation management, arc markers, buried electrical conduits for target systems, a multi-storey control tower, and a climate-controlled sentry shack. Once FP6 is operational, FP4 will be upgraded with four recapitalized firing lanes, crossing lanes, protective berms, tank table positions, UXO clearance, vegetation management, arc markers, buried electrical conduits New approximately 455 m² climate-controlled administrative building, and refurbishment of the existing control tower. Contract Award and Anticipated Security Requirements To be eligible for contract award, a proponent will be required to, among other things, actively hold or obtain all required security clearance(s) prior to the date of the award, as further detailed in the solicitation documents. The anticipated security clearance level for this contract is Designated Organization Screening (DOS). Industrial Security Program Sponsorship Defence Construction Canada (DCC) is providing design-builders early access to the security clearance application process through sponsorship under its Industrial Security Program (ISP). Accordingly, design-builders that intend to submit a proposal for this project and that do not actively hold the above identified security clearance(s) should begin forthwith the security clearance application process by applying through DCC’s ISP. Under this program, DCC may, at its entire discretion, provide preliminary assistance to all the potential proponents with their respective security clearance sponsorship process. To begin the security clearance sponsorship process, please submit a sponsorship request application to DCC by following the steps identified on DCC’s website at: https://www.dcc-cdc.gc.ca/industry/security-requirements. In their sponsorship request application to DCC, design-builders are asked to quote the following information, among other things:   Advance Procurement Notice (APN) number (Project number on the MERX notice); Contract number 86689 CN; and Level of clearance requested to be sponsored for. Sponsorship Process Upon receipt, DCC will review the sponsorship request application and will communicate directly with the design-builders to provide assistance for the completion of the sponsorship request packages. Once DCC has determined, at its entire discretion, that a design-builder:   has started the sponsorship process prior to the solicitation (Contract number listed on their request for sponsorship) being advertised on MERX, has met all the material requirements of the sponsorship request package, and has submitted a proposal or a bid DCC will send the documents to the Public Services and Procurement Canada’s (PSPC) Contract Security Program (CSP). Following receipt of the sponsorship request package, the CSP will communicate directly with the proponent regarding any further steps or actions to be undertaken or the status of the sponsorship request package processing. At such time, the proponent will need to promptly cooperate with CSP to ensure that the process is completed as soon as possible. Questions Any questions pertaining to the sponsoring process through the ISP can be addressed to: Telephone Number: (613) 998-8974; or Email address: ISP.Sponsorship@dcc-cdc.gc.ca Any questions relating to this Advance Procurement Notice can be addressed to: Yuriy Klitynskyy Team Lead Contract Services Defence Construction Canada 506 – 471 – 3972   Yuriy.Klitynskyy@dcc-cdc.gc.ca Disclaimer DCC is only providing assistance, at its entire discretion, for the above stated sponsorship process and does not provide any representations or guarantees that a sponsorship request package or a security clearance application forwarded by DCC to the CSP will be successful or result in the granting of the requested security clearance(s) by the CSP. At all times, the processing of a sponsorship request package or a security clearance application is subject to the respective terms, conditions, and timelines of DCC’s ISP sponsorship process and the CSP security clearance granting process. By applying to either of the aforementioned processes, the proponent agrees to bear any fees and risks associated with: (i) the completeness or accuracy, or lack thereof, of its application or related documents submitted under or in connection with either said processes, and (ii) the timeliness, or lack thereof, of any processing or granting of security clearance(s) under or in connection with either said processes. Notwithstanding anything else stated above, DCC shall in no event be liable to the proponent for any direct, indirect, incidental, special, consequential, punitive or exemplary damages arising out or in connection with the above stated sponsorship process.  Bidding and Documents are available on http://www.merx.com. Fees may apply; See https://www.merx.com/public/pricing for more information.

title: Romania – Feasibility study, advisory service, analysis – Servicii de proiectare faza studiu de fezabilitate (S.F.), conform H.G. nr. 907/2016, pentru proiectul de investiţie imobiliară: „Bază integrată de instruire pentru forțele cu destinație specială din Armata României în cazarma 3645 Mihai Bravu”, cod proiect 2025-I-3645
description: Serviciile care fac obiectul contractului sunt: – Studiu de Fezabilitate pentru obiectivul „Bază integrată de instruire pentru forţele cu destinaţie specială din Armata României în cazarma 3645 Mihai Bravu", conform H.G. nr. 907/2016, cu modificările şi completările ulterioare, în conformitate cu tema de proiectare; – Nota de prezentare, elaborată conform conţinutului-cadru prevăzut în Anexa nr. 4 a Regulamentului privind organizarea şi funcţionarea Consiliului tehnico-economic al Ministerului Apărării Naţionale, aprobat prin Ordinul M.94/2017; – Studiu topografic în sistem STEREO 70; – Studiu geotehnic, verificat de verificator de proiecte atestat Af; – Studiu hidrogeologic; – Studiu balistic, necesar pentru fundamentarea soluţiilor de amenajare şi de siguranţă aferente obiectelor de instrucţie cu tragere (poligoane de tragere, shooting house, poligoane de antrenament), inclusiv stabilirea zonelor de siguranţă şi a soluţiilor de captare/oprire a proiectilelor; – Studiu de obstacolare şi documentaţia aferentă obţinerii avizului Autorităţii Aeronautice Civile Române (A.A.C.R.), necesar în raport cu heliportul prevăzut în cadrul obiectivului şi cu servituţile aeronautice aplicabile amplasamentului; – Studiu de circulaţie, necesar pentru fundamentarea soluţiilor de acces, a drumurilor şi platformelor interioare şi a legăturii cu reţeaua de drumuri existentă; – Studiu de soluţie şi de coexistenţă, necesar pentru racordarea la reţelele de utilităţi şi pentru stabilirea condiţiilor de coexistenţă cu reţelele şi obiectivele existente în zonă; – Raport de conformare NZEB, întocmit de auditor energetic pentru clădiri atestat; – Elaborarea documentaţiilor pentru obţinerea avizelor şi acordurilor solicitate prin Certificatul de Urbanism, precum şi asistenţă acordată Autorităţii contractante în vederea obţinerii avizelor, inclusiv Documentaţia pentru obţinerea acordului de principiu de securitate la incendiu şi documentaţia pentru obţinerea avizului privind sănătatea populaţiei. Totodată, Prestatorul va asigura suport de specialitate Autorităţii contractante la prezentarea documentaţiei tehnico-economice în vederea obţinerii avizului C.T.E. al M.Ap.N. (prezentare în format .pptx sau similar pentru susţinerea documentaţiei întocmite în vederea avizării şi aprobării în şedinţa Consiliului Tehnico-Economic al Ministerului Apărării Naţionale). De asemenea, la solicitarea Autorităţii contractante, Prestatorul acordă asistenţă tehnică de specialitate şi transmite clarificări cu privire la documentaţia tehnico-economică elaborată de acesta, pe durata promovării fazelor următoare ale proiectului (elaborare D.T.A.C., P.Th. + D.E., execuţie lucrări). Clarificările se transmit exclusiv Autorităţii contractante, care le valorifică potrivit competenţelor proprii. Prestatorul nu participă la derularea procedurilor de atribuire subsecvente şi nu are acces la ofertele depuse ori la identitatea operatorilor economici participanţi. Numărul de zile până la care se pot solicita clarificări înainte de data limita de depunere a ofertelor/candidaturilor: 12. AC va răspunde în mod clar și complet la toate solicitările de clarificări în conformitate cu prevederile art. 69 și 70 din O.U.G. 114/2011 cu modificările și completările ulterioare, dar nu mai târziu de 6 zile înainte de data-limită stabilită pentru depunerea ofertelor.

title: IT Professional Services
description: The Canada Council for the Arts' Information Technology section requires access to qualified professional services providers to support ongoing IT operational requirements and project-based initiatives on an as-and-when-required basis. General requirement The Contractor must provide information technology professional services, on an as-and-when-requested basis, in support of the Canada Council’s operational, maintenance, enhancement, modernization, transformation and advisory requirements. The Contractor must actively support knowledge transfer to Canada Council personnel proportionate to the scope, complexity and duration of each engagement. Deliverables, documentation, training materials, presentations, knowledge transfer activities and related services may be required in English, French or both official languages, as specified in the applicable call-up. The Contractor must provide qualified resources, perform the authorized work and deliver all required outputs in accordance with the requirements of the Standing Offer and the applicable call-up. The Contractor must provide professional services in information technology across one or more of the following service streams: Stream 1 - Enterprise platforms and business applications Services may include the configuration, development, administration, enhancement, integration, maintenance and support of enterprise platforms and business applications, including Microsoft, Salesforce and Unit4 technologies. Stream 2 - Applications, integration and support Services may include the design, development, modernization, testing, deployment, integration, maintenance and support of custom-developed and commercial off-the-shelf applications, interfaces and related components. Stream 3 - Data, analytics and information management Services may include data architecture, data analysis, reporting, analytics, business intelligence, information management, database administration, data governance and data integration. Stream 4 - Architecture, cloud, infrastructure and cybersecurity Services may include enterprise, solution and integration architecture; cloud architecture and infrastructure; cybersecurity; identity and access management; network services; and related advisory, implementation and support activities. Stream 5 - Project, Program and Change Management Support Services may include project and program management, project coordination, business and functional analysis, business process analysis, organizational change management, planning, governance, performance reporting and stakeholder engagement, documentation, knowledge transfer and training services. Stream 6 - User experience, accessibility and quality assurance Services may include user experience design, AI-enabled user experience and service design, accessibility assessment and remediation, testing and quality assurance. Stream 7 - Audit and advisory services Services may include audit and advisory services related to technology controls, compliance, governance, risk management, cybersecurity, platforms, applications, processes and IT operations. Stream 8 - Artificial intelligence, automation and emerging technologies Services may include, in accordance with the Government of Canada's artificial intelligence strategy, artificial intelligence strategy development, generative AI and machine learning advisory services, AI solution design and implementation, responsible AI governance, automation, intelligent search, knowledge management, AI-assisted service delivery, model evaluation, data readiness, and emerging technology assessment.

title: Financial Consultant - Saskatchewan for the Farm Debt Mediation Service (FDMS)
description: The Programs Branch (PB) of Agriculture and Agri-Food Canada (AAFC) has requirements on an “as and when requested” basis for professional resources with expertise and skillsets for the delivery of financial counselling and mediation services. This requirement is to establish a Task Authorization Contract with a qualified Contractor’s for services in Saskatchewan. It is intended to result in the award of 5 (five) contracts for 5 (five) years. The Farm Debt Mediation Service (FDMS) offers free financial counselling and mediation services to farmers who are having difficulties meeting their financial obligations. It is a voluntary, private and confidential service that brings farmers and their creditors together with a Mediator in a neutral forum to reach a mutually acceptable solution. The FDMS Administrator will assign a Financial Consultant and a Mediator to work with the farmer through the mediation process. Confidentiality is extremely important to the quality and effectiveness of the service. Information obtained from the farmer and their creditor(s) is used for the sole purpose of mediation and is shared only among the parties involved in the mediation process. The Financial Consultant will conduct a site visit, inventory all the farmer’s assets, create financial statements of the farming operation, develop a recovery plan for the purpose of reaching a financial arrangement between the farmer and their creditor(s), and attend mediation meeting(s). When the farmer and their creditor(s) agree upon a solution, the Mediator will draw-up an arrangement

title: Cloth, Coated, Nylon/Polyurethane, 235 g/m², CADPAT™ Multi-Terrain (MT) – Re-Tender
description: The Department of National Defence (DND), has a requirement for the production and supply of CADPAT-patterned clothing and associated items for the Canadian Armed Forces (CAF). This solicitation is subject to limited tendering. Only companies holding a valid and active licence to print CADPAT, issued by the Department of National Defence, will be invited to submit bids. The following licensed companies are eligible to participate in this solicitation: • Textiles Monterey (1996) Inc. / Monterey Textiles (1996) Inc. • Brookwood Companies Incorporated • Textil Santanderina, S.A. • NV Utexbel • Brittany Global Technologies Corporation Where a supplier has previously submitted samples to DND for the same or equivalent requirement, those samples may be retained and considered for use in support of the upcoming solicitation, subject to confirmation by DND that they remain representative of the proposed product and continue to meet the applicable technical requirements. Companies interested in obtaining a CADPAT printing licence are invited to contact: Requesting the Commercial Use of the Canadian Disruptive Pattern (CADPAT) - Canada.ca for information regarding the licensing process and eligibility requirements. By limiting the solicitation to organizations that currently hold a valid CADPAT printing licence, DND can ensure compliance with intellectual property, security, and technical requirements associated with the production of CADPAT-patterned materials. Request for Standing Offers (RFSO) package would be provided directly to the eligible licensed firms, increasing the likelihood of receiving compliant and competitive bids. At the same time, transparency is maintained by clearly identifying the eligibility requirements, listing the licensed companies eligible to participate, and providing information for other interested firms wishing to pursue a CADPAT printing licence for future opportunities.

description: Předmětem této veřejné zakázky je provedení činností dle projektové dokumentace s názvem „Sanace, rekultivace a revitalizace území po těžbě štěrkopísku u Hlučína – II. etapa“, zpracované v srpnu 2023 společností PUDIS a.s., IČO 45272891, VPÚ DECO PRAHA a.s., IČO: 60193280 pro stavební objekt SO 420.1 (Přeložka NN u SO 102) a stavebního objektu SO 453 (Přeložka VN u SO 102) z prosince 2013 a Slezskomoravské telekomunikace Opava spol. s r.o., IČO: 43964435 pro stavební objekt S0 492.2 (přeložka SLP O2) z dubna 2026, která je přílohou č. 3 ZD. Předmětem plnění jsou stavby dopravní a technické infrastruktury včetně potřebného začlenění do území v rámci úprav areálu bývalé štěrkovny, tj. výstavba pozemních komunikací, parkovišť, chodníků, kanalizace a vodovodu, úprava pravobřežní hráze a navýšení ochranné hráze. Jedná se o druhou etapu projektu Sanace, rekultivace a revitalizace území po těžbě štěrkopísku u Hlučína. Cílem prací je zajištění výstavby pozemních komunikací, parkovišť, chodníků, kanalizace a vodovodu, úpravy pravobřežní hráze a navýšení ochranné hráze, které povede k revitalizaci bývalého dobývacího prostoru štěrkopísku a ke zlepšení a rozšíření rekreačního potenciálu dané oblasti.

title: Betrieb der hydraulischen Sicherung Deponie Freiheit III – Wartung/ Instandhaltung Pumpen-/ Anlagentechnik
description: Die MDSE betreibt als Projektträgerin auf Grundlage einer behördlichen Anordnung dauerhaft die hydraulische Sicherung der Deponie Freiheit III und ist für die ordnungsgemäße Hebung/ Sammlung/ Ableitung anfallender Grund-/ Oberflächenwässer aus dem Deponiebereich verantwortlich. Bei den Hebungswässern handelt es sich geogen/ anthropogen bedingt um stark mineralisierte Wässer, die zu erheblichen Ausfällungen und Ablagerungen (vorwiegend Eisen(III)-hydroxid (braun), aber auch Eisen(II)-sulfid (schwarz)) im gesamten Ableitungssystem führen. Um die Funktionstüchtigkeit der Gefahrenabwehrmaßnahme der hydraulischen Sicherung der Deponie Freiheit III jederzeit zu gewährleisten, sind Arbeiten zur Wartung/ Instandhaltung der Pumpen-/ Anlagentechnik erforderlich. Diese Leistungen werden von der MDSE vergeben und sind Gegenstand dieser Ausschreibung.

title: APN - BASE JANITORIAL SERVICES CFB SHILO, MANITOBA
description: Advance Procurement Notice BASE JANITORIAL SERVICES CFB SHILO, MANITOBA (with Security Requirements) Purpose of this Advance Procurement Notice This is not a bid solicitation nor a request for proposals. In the context of the major investments announced by the Government and to foster a proactive partnership with industry, DCC is issuing this Advance Procurement Notice (APN) to inform contractors of an upcoming contract opportunity at CFB Shilo, Shilo Manitoba. The purpose of this APN is to allow contractors to assess their capacity and interest in participating, and to prepare adequately for the potential solicitation process, notably by initiating any necessary steps. This is a preliminary notice regarding a potential contract, which includes security requirements. The purpose of this APN is to allow interested contractors to initiate, if required, the sponsorship process to obtain the necessary clearances or security clearances (if applicable). Please note that there is no guarantee that this contract will proceed or that security clearances will be granted within the anticipated timelines or at all as part of the sponsorship process. Description of the Project and Services The Department of National Defence and Defence Construction Canada intends to put in place a contract to provide all labour, material, supervision and equipment to supply janitorial services at CFB Shilo, Manitoba.  In general, the work includes, but not limited to: Janitorial cleaning services (internal and external elements) General Requirements wipe down benches, exercise equipment and weight machines; dusting of blinds; vacuuming of curtains and drapery; cleaning/stocking of dispensers; clean & disinfect door handles, handrails and switch plates cleaning and disinfecting of drinking fountains; spot clean/ replace of entrance mats and grates; floor strip/refinishing; sweep/vacuum and damp mop of flooring; vacuum (automatic type) pools; clean and disinfect pool deck; clean, damp mop and disinfect sauna room; cleaning and disinfect bathroom fixtures; waste removal; glass cleaning Other Tasks carpet/furniture shampooing and steam cleaning The approximate estimated cost for these services is $4,000,000.00 over two (2) years with the potential for three (3) additional one (1) year extensions and an increase in value up to $6,000,000.00. The estimated total potential value is approximately $10,000,000.00 over a possible five (5) year period. It is anticipated that the following solicitation will proceed as noted in the table below. This is conditional on the contract receiving approval to proceed from DND. Contract Number:  SLSO2796 Title: Base Janitorial Services Total Potential Value: $10,000,000.00 Anticipated Posting: November 2026 Anticipated Contract Commencement: April 2027 Contract Award and Anticipated Security Requirements To be eligible for contract award, a bidder will be required to, among other things, actively hold or obtain all required security clearance(s) prior to the date of the award, as further detailed in the solicitation documents. The anticipated security clearance level for this contract is Designated Organization Screening (DOS). Industrial Security Program Sponsorship Defence Construction Canada (DCC) is providing contractors early access to the security clearance application process through sponsorship under its Industrial Security Program (ISP). Accordingly, contractors that intend to submit a bid for this project and that do not actively hold the above identified security clearance(s) should begin forthwith the security clearance application process by applying through DCC’s ISP. Under this program, DCC may, at its entire discretion, provide preliminary assistance to all the potential bidders with their respective security clearance sponsorship process. To begin the security clearance sponsorship process, please submit a sponsorship request application to DCC by following the steps identified on DCC’s website at: https://www.dcc-cdc.gc.ca/industry/security-requirements. In their sponsorship request application to DCC, consultants or contractors are asked to quote the following information, among other things: Advance Procurement Notice (APN) number (Project number on the MERX notice); Contract number SLSO2796; and Level of clearance requested to be sponsored for. Sponsorship Process Upon receipt, DCC will review the sponsorship request application and will communicate directly with the consultants or contractors to provide assistance for the completion of the sponsorship request packages. Once DCC has determined, at its entire discretion, that a consultant or contractor: has started the sponsorship process prior to the solicitation (Contract number listed on their request for sponsorship) being advertised on MERX, has  met all the material requirements of the sponsorship request package, and has submitted a proposal or a bid DCC will  send the documents to the Public Services and Procurement Canada’s (PSPC) Contract Security Program (CSP). Following receipt of the sponsorship request package, the CSP will communicate directly with the proponent or bidder regarding any further steps or actions to be undertaken or the status of the sponsorship request package processing. At such time, the proponent or bidder will need to promptly cooperate with CSP  to ensure that the process is completed as soon as possible. Questions Any questions pertaining to the sponsoring process through the ISP can be addressed to: Telephone Number: (613) 998-8974; or Email address: ISP.Sponsorship@dcc-cdc.gc.ca Any questions relating to this Advance Procurement Notice can be addressed to: Brad Jeaurond Coordinator, Contract Services Defence Construction Canada 204-765-3000, ext. 258-4094 Bradley.Jeaurond@dcc-cdc.gc.ca Disclaimer DCC is only providing assistance, at its entire discretion, for the above stated sponsorship process  and does not provide any representations  or guarantees that a sponsorship request package or a security clearance application forwarded by DCC to the CSP will be successful or result in the granting of the requested security clearance(s) by the CSP. At all times, the processing of a sponsorship request package or a security clearance application is subject to the respective terms, conditions, and timelines of DCC’s ISP sponsorship process and the CSP security clearance granting process. By applying to either of the aforementioned processes, the proponent or bidder agrees to bear any fees and risks associated with: (i) the completeness or accuracy, or lack thereof, of its application or related documents submitted under or in connection with either said processes, and (ii) the timeliness, or lack thereof, of any processing or granting of security clearance(s) under or in connection with either said processes. Notwithstanding anything else stated above, DCC shall in no event be liable to the bidder or proponent for any direct, indirect, incidental, special, consequential, punitive or exemplary damages arising out or in connection with the above stated  sponsorship process.Bidding and Documents are available on http://www.merx.com. Fees may apply; See https://www.merx.com/public/pricing for more information.

Toutes les phases SIA 31 à 53 doivent être chiffrées à part pour l'architecte dont la phase 31 est quasiment achevée et pour laquelle un quota d'heures est prévu pour l'étude des façades et la dépose du dossier de la demande préalable.

Le projet est la transformation et l'agrandissement de l'école existante. Le montant total des travaux pour les CFC 1, 2, 4 et 9 est de CHF 10'151'570.— HT, hors honoraires et hors frais / taxes (voir le détail du devis général remis en annexe).

title: APN-AEC11 SOURCE CONTROL (DESIGN BID BUILD) 19 WING, CFB COMOX, LAZO, BC
description: ADVANCE PROCUREMENT NOTICE AEC11 Source control (design bid build) 19 wing, CFB Comox, Lazo, BC (with security requirements) 1. PURPOSE OF THIS ADVANCE PROCUREMENT NOTICE This is not a bid solicitation nor a request for proposals. In the context of the major investments announced by the Government and to foster a proactive partnership with industry, DCC is issuing this Advance Procurement Notice (APN) to inform contractors of an upcoming contract opportunity at 19 Wing, CFB Comox, Lazo, BC. The purpose of this APN is to allow contractors to assess their capacity and interest in participating, and to prepare adequately for the potential solicitation process. This is a preliminary notice regarding a potential contract, which includes security requirements. The purpose of this APN is to allow interested contractors to initiate, if required, the sponsorship process to obtain the necessary clearances or security clearances (if applicable). Please note that there is no guarantee that this contract will proceed or that security clearances will be granted within the anticipated timelines or at all as part of the sponsorship process. Please note that this project may include Indigenous businesses participation component in accordance with the Procurement Strategy for Indigenous Business (PSIB). 2. DESCRIPTION OF THE PROJECT AND SERVICES It is anticipated that the following solicitation will proceed as noted in the table below. This is conditional on the contract receiving approval to proceed from DND. APN or Contract Number: 87758 Approximate Estimate: $9,300,000 Anticipated Posting: January 2027 Description: Remediation of PFAS-impacted soils at CFB Comox through in-situ soil mixing (chemical) and stabilization, selective excavation, off-site disposal, drainage improvements, and site restoration. The work is located within a former detonation and training area and is subject to UXO risk, environmental protection requirements, and tight seasonal construction windows. Construction will be completed in two distinct phases due to schedule constraints, UXO sequencing, and constructability considerations. 3. CONTRACT AWARD AND ANTICIPATED SECURITY REQUIREMENTS To be eligible for contract award, a proponent will be required to, among other things, actively hold or obtain all required security clearance(s) prior to the date of the award, as further detailed in the solicitation documents. The anticipated security clearance level for this contract is Designated Organization Screening (DOS). 4. Industrial Security Program Sponsorship Defence Construction Canada (DCC) is providing contractors early access to the security clearance application process through sponsorship under its Industrial Security Program (ISP). Accordingly, contractors that intend to submit a proposal for this project and that do not actively hold the above identified security clearance(s) should begin forthwith the security clearance application process by applying through DCC’s ISP. Under this program, DCC may, at its entire discretion, provide preliminary assistance to all the potential proponents with their respective security clearance sponsorship process. To begin the security clearance sponsorship process, please submit a sponsorship request application to DCC by following the steps identified on DCC’s website at: https://www.dcc-cdc.gc.ca/industry/security-requirements. In their sponsorship request application to DCC, contractors are asked to quote the following information, among other things: Advance Procurement Notice (APN) number, as identified in Section 2 of this APN; and Level of clearance requested to be sponsored, as identified in Section 3 of this APN. 5. Sponsorship Process Upon receipt, DCC will review the sponsorship request application and will communicate directly with the contractors to provide assistance for the completion of the sponsorship request packages. Once DCC has determined, at its entire discretion, that a contractor: has started the sponsorship process prior to the solicitation being advertised on MERX, has met all the material requirements of the sponsorship request package prior to the closing date indicated in the solicitation, and has submitted a proposal.   DCC will send the documents to the Public Services and Procurement Canada’s (PSPC) Contract Security Program (CSP). Note – Contractors that do not submit a proposal will not be able to attain clearance through this sponsorship process. Following receipt of the sponsorship request package, the CSP will communicate directly with the proponent or tenderer regarding any further steps or actions to be undertaken or the status of the sponsorship request package processing. At such time, the proponent will need to promptly cooperate with CSP to ensure that the process is completed as soon as possible. 6. Questions Any questions pertaining to the sponsoring process through the ISP can be addressed to: Telephone Number: (613) 998-8974; or Email address: ISP.Sponsorship@dcc-cdc.gc.ca Any questions relating to this Advance Procurement Notice can be addressed to: Sarah Kinnon Coordinator, Contract Services Defence Construction Canada (236) 255-1745 Sarah.kinnon@dcc-cdc.gc.ca 7. Disclaimer DCC is only providing assistance, at its entire discretion, for the above stated sponsorship process  and does not provide any representations  or guarantees that a sponsorship request package or a security clearance application forwarded by DCC to the CSP will be successful or result in the granting of the requested security clearance(s) by the CSP. At all times, the processing of a sponsorship request package or a security clearance application is subject to the respective terms, conditions, and timelines of DCC’s ISP sponsorship process and the CSP security clearance granting process. By applying to either of the aforementioned processes, the proponent agrees to bear any fees and risks associated with: (i) the completeness or accuracy, or lack thereof, of its application or related documents submitted under or in connection with either said processes, and (ii) the timeliness, or lack thereof, of any processing or granting of security clearance(s) under or in connection with either said processes. Notwithstanding anything else stated above, DCC shall in no event be liable to the proponent for any direct, indirect, incidental, special, consequential, punitive or exemplary damages arising out or in connection with the above stated sBidding and Documents are available on http://www.merx.com. Fees may apply; See https://www.merx.com/public/pricing for more information.

title: AFP for Lease of Discovery Park at Michoud Assembly Facility
description: This Announcement for Proposals (AFP) solicits proposals for lease of Discovery Park which represents a selection of available real property assets at MAF. The real property assets (The Property) known as Discovery Park, and shown in Exhibit A, are as follows: 1. Approximately 45 Acres of Greenspace: This tract of land lies on the northern extent of the facility and is bounded by Old Gentilly Road (publicly accessible roadway) as well as Mercury, Uranus and Venus Drives, which are interior to the security fencing. The acreage is currently classified as underutilized greenspace. The tract�s frontage to Old Gentilly Road has availability to direct connection with municipal power, potable water and sewer services. These utilities may be established with each respective service carrier. Please see Exhibit B for a listing of municipal resources which may assist in performing diligence for these service agreements. The acreage includes what were previously large sections of parking areas that supported a previously demolished building. These areas are past their useful service life and thus have been considered greenspace for appraisal purposes. 2. Building 351: Building 351 is an approximately 32,000 sf mixed used facility. The building is subdivided into two main areas: formal event space and cafeteria. The building currently is connected to the MAF utility grids. As a result, some determination will need to be made with respect to severing the building from those utilities and re-establishing utility services from the previously mentioned municipal service providers based upon the proposer�s concept of use. This reconfiguration would be made subject to NASA�s approval and terms of use. The Proposer may choose to propose on either asset separately or a combination of the two. NASA shall have the authority to execute either one or multiple leases in the event The Proposer chooses to include a combination of both assets in their submission. NASA intends to utilize Enhanced Use Lease authority as set forth in 51 U.S.C. 20145 as the sole means to enter into a lease(s) for The Property. The Proposer will assume any and all financial responsibilities for operations and maintenance of The Property under such a lease. The terms and conditions in the attached Model Enhanced Use Lease (EUL) generally demonstrate all the Proposer responsibilities including those maintenance and operational parameters. While The Property has existing utilities which serve other portions of the facility, the Proposer should not assume that any existing utilities will be available for use and that any utilities required for development will be at the sole cost of the Proposer. The Property will be available at award in �as is� condition for no less than one ten (10) year base term. The contractor's request shall explain in detail the requirements for mercury, identify specifically the parts to contain mercury, and explain the method of protection against mercury escape. Such a request will be forwarded directly to the Procurement Contracting Officer with a copy to the applicable Government Inspector. Upon approval by the Contracting Officer, the vendor will provide a "Warning Plate" stating that metallic mercury is a functional part of the item and will include name and location of that part. The use of mercury, mercury compounds, or mercury-bearing instruments and/or equipment in a manner which might cause contamination in the manufacture, assembly, or test of material on this contract is prohibited. The most probable causes of contamination are direct-connected manometers, mercury vacuum pumps, mercury seals, or the handling of mercury in the immediate vicinity. Mercury switches, mercury in glass thermometers, standard cells and other items containing mercury may be used if they are located so as not to constitute a contamination hazard. If external contamination by metallic mercury occurs or is suspected, the following test may be used to determine whether contamination by metallic mercury exists or whether corrective cleaning measures have been effective. Enclose the equipment in a polyethylene bag or close-fitting airtight container for eight hours at room temperature (70 degrees F minimum).Sample the trapped air and if mercury vapor concentration is 0.01 mg/cu meter or more, the material is mercury contaminated insofar as the requirements of this contract are concerned. These requirements shall be included in any subcontract or purchase order hereunder and the Contractor shall insure SubContractor compliance with these requirements. Technical questions pertaining to these requirements shall be referred to the Procurement Contracting Officer via the cognizant Administrative Contracting Officer. title: Delivery and installation of a ICP Reactive ion etcher for silicon dielctrics
description: DTU Nanolab wishes to acquire a high ion density source reactive ion etcher for oxides and nitrides of silicon to become its new primary instrument for 150 mm wafer processing. Delivery is expected no later than Q3 2027. The Instrument will be installed in the DTU Nanolab cleanroom - a university facility providing a comprehensive suite of micro- and nanofabrication tools. It serves a diverse community of over 200 active users, ranging from novice students to experienced researchers, as well a high percentage of commercial clients. As an open access tool, the Instrument must support the full spectrum of etching of silicon-based dielectrics, from sub 100 nm nanostructures defined by electron beam lithography to depths of several tens of microns. Meeting these demands requires exceptional process controllability and tunability: the system must perform ultra precise, low-rate etches (< 100 nm/min) with smooth and straight sidewalls and minimal undercut for shallow features, alongside high etch rate deep etches (approaching 500 nm/min). It must also accommodate all silicon dielectrics of the form SixNy, SixOx and SixOyNz, and be compatible with mask materials including Si, Cr, e-beam resists and UV/DUV photoresists with high mask selectivity for all these masking materials. The user interface must be intuitive and user friendly. The Instrument should be engineered to the highest industrial standards to minimize maintenance, and any required servicing must be straightforward and efficient. The instrument must be configured for 150 mm wafer processing and a complete kit enabling the processing of 200 mm wafers must be included in the tender as an option. Furthermore, DTU will have the option to purchase one more ICP Reactive ion etcher for silicon dielctrics identical to the initial instrument.

title: Udbud af hovedentreprisekontrakt med fast entreprisesum uden mulighed for regulering ved mængdeafvigelser vedrørende forstærkning af Ballum Dige
description: Digelaget i Brede Ådalen ("Digelaget") er en lokal forening, der står for vedligeholdelse og sikring af diger langs Brede Å for at forhindre oversvømmelser af de tilstødende landbrugsarealer og dalstrøg. Digelagets arbejde består derfor oftest i at vedligeholde digekroner og skråninger for at sikre stabilitet mod vandtryk. Digelaget ønsker nu på strækningen fra Rømø Dæmningen og sydpå til Vesterende, der udgør i alt ca. 7.500 meter, at få det eksisterende Ballum Dige forstærket med klæg og sand. Arbejdet vil også omfatte udgravning og tildannelse af søområde ifm indvinding af de til Ballum Dige benyttede sand- og klæg-forekomster. På denne baggrund ønsker Digelaget at indgå én bygge- og anlægskontrakt ("Kontrakten") med én fast entreprisesum uden mulighed for regulering ved mængdeafvigelser. Entreprenøren bærer mængderisikoen. Kontrakten vil i hovedtræk omfatte følgende arbejder (de anslåede mængder for hver af de nedenstående arbejder fremgår af tilbudslisten, der indgår som en del af det samlede udbudsmateriale): 1. Fræsning af vækstlaget på dige (på eksisterende diges forskråning, forland og digekrone) 2. Afgravning af vækstlag og midlertidig deponering heraf på eksisterende diges forskråning, forland, digekrone og på bagskråning 3. Opgravning fra eksisterende dige, flytning og indbygning af råjord i diget 4. Opgravning fra eksisterende dige og bortskaffelse af råjord i diget 5. Opgravning fra søerne, flytning og indbygning af klæg 6. Genudlægning af vækstlag samt græssåning på den nye digeprofil. Hertil suppleres med tilkørsel af vækstlagsjord fra søerne 7. De til entreprisen nødvendige mængder råjord og klæg indvindes af entreprenøren i forbindelse med udgravning af nye søer tæt ved delprojektet. Materialerne transporteres til diget og indbygges af entreprenøren. Søerne holdes tørre af entreprenøren i forbindelse med gravearbejderne 8. Færdiggørelse af søernes brinker og reetablering af berørte arealer omkring søerne 9. Gødskning og græssåning af alle berørte arealer Alle de arealer, hvor der skal udføres arbejder, er beliggende ved Ballum i Tønder Kommune. Det klæg, der skal anvendes til brug for forstrækningen, leveres som en bygherreleverance (estimerede værdi udgør ca. 15-16 mio. kr.). Selve transporten af klæget vil være omfattet af de arbejder, der er tilknyttet til Kontrakten. Foruden dette omfattes af Kontrakten et mindre supplerende indkøb og levering samt udlægning af egnet stabilt grus eller knust beton til vedligeholdelse af interimsveje og arbejdsveje fra opgravningssted frem til digets indbygningssteder. Digelaget kan ikke stille el til rådighed, men kan være behjælpelig. Arbejderne med selve digebyggeriet skal udføres fra marts/april 2027 til oktober 2028 i tidsrummet fra kl. 04.00–18.00, dog under forudsætning af at dette ikke strider imod øvrig regulering, herunder tilladelsen fra Kystdirektoratet. Dertil kommer, at det er forventningen, at arbejderne på opgravningsstederne kan påbegyndes cirka en måned tidligere, dvs. i februar 2027. Af hensyn til digesikkerheden er entreprenøren forpligtet til at holde pause i udførelsen fra og med oktober 2027 til februar 2028, hvorefter arbejderne kan genoptages. På tidspunktet for udbuddets offentliggørelse har Digelaget ikke modtaget endelig tilladelse fra Kystdirektoratet til kystbeskyttelse, ligesom Digelaget heller ikke på dette tidspunkt har modtaget udlednings- samt landzonetilladelse fra Tønder Kommune. På denne baggrund tager Digelaget derfor udtrykkeligt forbehold for at annullere udbuddet, hvis endelige tilladelser ikke opnås. Digelaget tager ligeledes udtrykkeligt forbehold for at afvente indgåelse af Kontrakten med den vindende tilbudsgiver, indtil de endelige tilladelser er opnået. Yderligere tager Digelaget udtrykkeligt forbehold for at annullere udbuddet, hvis Digelaget ikke modtager den nødvendige finansiering fra Tønder Kommune til projektets gennemførelse, ligesom Digelaget i dette tilfælde også tager udtrykkeligt forbehold for at afvente indgåelse af Kontrakten med den vindende tilbudsgiver. Digelaget har ikke opdelt den udbudte bygge- og anlægskontrakt i delkontrakter, idet Digelaget vurderer, at en sådan opdeling vil medføre en række uhensigtsmæssige tekniske, juridiske og praktiske grænseflader med deraf følgende risiko for forøgede transaktionsomkostninger og risikoeksponering for Digelaget. Særligt dokumenterne arbejdsbeskrivelse for arbejdsplads, arbejdsbeskrivelse for færdselsregulerende foranstaltninger, Asfalt - AAB-SAB-P, AAB-SAB-P SOS og AAB-SAB Jordarbejder indeholder en udførlig beskrivelse af de opgaver, som er omfattet af Kontrakten. Enhver henvisning til standarder skal forstås som en henvisning til den nævnte standard eller tilsvarende. Opfylder tilbudsgiver ikke den nævnte standard, men tilsvarende, skal tilbudsgiver i tilbuddet dokumentere, at den tilbudte løsning på de relevante parametre er tilsvarende. Udbuddet gennemføres elektronisk ved brug af udbudsportalen www.udbuddet.dk. Tilbudsgiver skal derfor oprettes som licenshaver hos www.udbuddet.dk. Oprettelse kan ske uden omkostning. Spørgsmål vedrørende www.udbuddet.dk skal stilles direkte via support-funktionen (tlf. 70227007). Der ydes ikke vederlag for tilbudsgivernes deltagelse i udbudsprocessen. Tilbudsgiverne opfordres til at foretage en besigtigelse af den strækning, hvor der skal ske forstærkning. Dette særligt af hensyn til, at Kontrakten udbydes med én fast entreprisesum uden mulighed for regulering ved mængdeafvigelser. Det betyder, at entreprenørens vederlag ikke reguleres, uanset om de anførte mængder i tilbudslisten, der danner grundlag for beregning af den faste entreprisesum, måtte vise sig anderledes under udførelsen. Derfor kan Bygherre også stille de 3D-målinger, der danner grundlag for mængderne i tilbudslisten, til rådighed som en del af udbudsmaterialet.

title: Portugal – Research and development services and related consultancy services – Framework contract for EUDA scientific studies support services
description: The purpose of this procurement procedure is to purchase capacity to support the Agency in the preparation of high-quality scientific services and overall to increase the Agency’s timeliness, anticipatory and responsive capacity. The Agency requires access to supporting specialised expertise in the design, conduct, and reporting of different types of scientific work. Outputs may include reports, digital dashboards, AI based tools, methodological and reporting guidelines, training materials, workshops, databases, collection of literature, etc. The present procurement procedure is aimed at supporting the Agency to rapidly mobilise external expertise in a flexible and efficient manner, ensuring responsiveness to evolving scientific priorities and emerging evidence needs. The activities resulting from this procedure are expected to support the EUDA in monitoring drug markets, use of substances and their consequences. They will also help identify the evidence needed to inform responses in terms of establishing trends, examining emerging threats and tracking developments over time and between settings. Ultimately, this is expected to strengthen the preparedness of the Agency, and of the EU as a whole, to respond to drug-related harms.

title: Netherlands – IT services: consulting, software development, Internet and support – Europese Openbare Aanbesteding Informatiemanagementsysteem TSG ten behoeve van Zorginstituut Nederland
description: In het TSG zal het Zorginstituut, in samenwerking met betrokken partijen, voor elk nieuw geneesmiddel op basis van een risicoduiding bekijken of een beoordeling nodig is, wat voor beoordeling dat moet zijn en wie deze uitvoert. Deze samenwerking moet ondersteund worden met behulp van een informatiemanagementsysteem (IMS). Door informatie op één plek te verzamelen waar de verschillende partijen toegang tot hebben, kan het risicogericht werken worden uitgevoerd en wordt communicatie hierover ondersteund, zoals beschreven in het TSG. De informatie voor het risicogericht werken wordt verzameld vanuit de Horizonscan en mogelijk andere bronnen. In eerste instantie moet het IMS het nieuwe instroomproces volgens TSG praktisch uitvoerbaar maken, deze wetgeving gaat in per 1 januari 2028. In de doorontwikkelfase kan verdere ondersteuning van de huidige situatie van het geneesmiddelbeoordelingsproces (organisatorische, procesmatige, gegevens en functionele context) evenals nog uit te werken elementen, in het IMS.

title: South Haven and New Buffalo Maintenance Dredging
description: The U.S. Army Corps of Engineers (USACE), Detroit District is seeking contractor with the capability to provide construction services for Maintenance Dredging for South Haven Harbor and New Buffalo Harbor. The project includes mobilize to dredge of both New Buffalo Harbor, located in Berrien County, Michigan and South Haven Habor, located in Van Buren County, Michigan. De-mobilize when dredging is completed. NO SOLICITATION, SPECIFICATION OR DRAWING are available for this Notice. The Government intends to solicit this opportunity as an Invitation for Bid (IFB). The IFB is intended to be issued as a 100% Small Business Set Aside, and the Government intends to award to the lowest priced bid that is determined to be responsible. The North American Industrial Classification System (NAICS) code for this work is 237990, Other Heavy and Civil Engineering Construction, which has a small business size standard of $37.0 million in average annual receipts with the Dredging and Surface Cleanup Activities exception. General Information The Government intends to issue a Firm-Fixed Price (FFP) Construction Contract. The estimated anticipated Solicitation Posting Date: April 7, 2026 The estimated anticipated Bid Due Date: May 7, 2026 The estimated magnitude of construction is between $500,000 and $1,000,000. The Product Service Code is Y1KF ? Construction of Dredging Facilities. The solicitation package materials, documents, drawings, specifications, and attachments to the anticipated solicitation will be available only electronically and via the System for Award Management (SAM). Contractors can access SAM free of charge at www.sam.gov. The solicitation posted on SAM.gov will include a link to all solicitation documents which will be stored in the Solicitation module of the Procurement Integrated enterprise Environment (PIEE) system. Contractors may register for PIEE free of charge at https://piee.eb.mil/. In order for interest contractors to conduct business with the Federal Government, contractors must be registered in PIEE prior to the bid due date and in SAM.gov prior to any award. Hard copy documents will NOT be supplied by the Government to any interested parties as a result of this Pre-Solicitation Notice or the upcoming Solicitation. Electronic bid submission will be required through the PIEE Solicitation Module suite at https://piee.eb.mil. Please note the Government will not be maintaining a bidder list during the solicitation period. However, vendors are strongly encouraged to review the ?Interest Vendor List? found on sam.gov for this requirement.

title: USCG REGIONAL MULTIPLE AWARD CONSTRUCTION CONTRACT (RMACC III) Vendor Outreach Matchmaking Event (VOME)
description: REGISTRATION IS NOW OPEN! USCG REGIONAL MULTIPLE AWARD CONSTRUCTION CONTRACT (NMACC III) VENDOR OUTREACH MATCHMAKING EVENT (VOME) On Wednesday, September 10, 2025, from 9:00 a.m. � 4:00 p.m. ET, the U.S. Department of Homeland Security (DHS) Office of Small and Disadvantaged Business Utilization (OSDBU) in collaboration with the U.S. Coast Guard (USCG) will host a Vendor Outreach Matchmaking Event (VOME) for the third generation of the Regional Multiple Award Construction Indefinite Delivery Indefinite Quantity Contracts (RMACC III). This event will focus on matchmaking for small and other than small businesses that provide construction, architectural and engineering, and construction related services. Registration is be limited to those firms interested in the USCG RMACC III requirement as either a prime or subcontractor for any of the regions are encouraged to register for this event. Prior to registering, firms should review the active RMACC III Opportunity ID 70Z08725RRMACC003 and the published artifacts from the Virtual Industry Day (see links below). The table below reflects the planned set-aside by each region: Formerly July 2025 Name Change Planned Set-Aside District 1 USCG Northeast Region 8(a) District 5 USCG East Region SDVOSB District 7 USCG Southeast Region 8(a) District 7.5 USCG Southeast Region - Puerto Rico, US Virgin Islands 100% SB District 8 USCG Heartland Region Total/100% SB District 9 USCG Great Lakes Region HUBZone District 11 USCG Southwest Region 8(a) District 13 USCG Northwest Region SDVOSB District 14 USCG Oceania Region 8(a) District 17 USCG Arctic Region HUBZone; 8(a) The RMACC III VOME will be held virtually to connect businesses in a variety of ways, which includes the discussion of potential subcontracting opportunities; forming joint-venture or teaming partnerships; and facilitating discussions that may lead to mentor-prot�g� relationships. This event provides a virtual space where both large and small businesses can present their core capabilities. Each meeting will be 15 minutes established by matching of core competencies and lines of businesses as identified by each firms North American Industry Classification System (NAICS) Code(s). Those small businesses that are primarily engaged in supplies/services under the following NAICS Sector and Subsectors should attend this event: 23 Construction 236 Construction of Buildings 237 Heavy and Civil Engineering Construction 238 Specialty Trade Contractors 532 Rental and Leasing Services (specifically, those relating to construction equipment rental and leasing services) 541 Professional, Scientific and Technical Services (specifically, those relating to architectural and engineering services) 562 Waste Management and Remediation Services (specifically, those relating to environmental remediation services) Registration is now open for the RMACC III VOME until 11:59 PM EDT, Monday, September 8, 2025. All firms can begin to request meetings on Monday, August 25, 2025. The delay between registration and the date to request meetings is to allow for a robust database of participating firms. We encourage businesses to upload their capability statements when registering for the RMACC III VOME. Each registrant will request to meet with other businesses that align with services or products they provide or are seeking. Registration does not guarantee a meeting and each business will decide which requests meet their needs by acceptance of the meeting request(s). What This Event Is: � Virtual one-on-one 15-minute meeting(s) between two (large to small or small to small) businesses. � An opportunity to present capabilities and to have potential discussions outside of the VOME. � An opportunity for small businesses to establish a relationship with large or other small businesses currently doing business with DHS or other federal agencies and/or actively seeking opportunities. What This Event Is NOT: � A virtual Vendor Outreach Session. There are no meetings with DHS Small Business Specialists. � A webinar event or training. All small and large businesses are required to register at https://mbmapp.com/event/rmaccvome2025 and provide the required information including a capability statement and a valid point of contact email address in their profile compatible with various virtual meeting tools (e.g., Zoom, Microsoft Teams, WebEx, etc.). Once your firm receives confirmation of a meeting from the scheduling site, you will receive a follow-up email with the virtual meeting invitation. If you do not see a meeting invitation, check your spam or junk mail folders. A platform tutorial is also being provided in this notice outlining the registration and meeting process. Please be advised that if connectivity issues occur using the virtual tools, the session may be conducted telephonically or rescheduled. Questions on the RMACC III VOME should be sent to OSDBU.VOS@hq.dhs.gov.

title: Switzerland – Technical services – Zukunft Bahnhof Bern, Bausteine 1,2,4, 3a, 3b, Umweltbaubegleitung: 3'000 h externe Projektleitung
description: Mit dieser Ausschreibung wird das Mandat «Umweltbaubegleitung» im Rahmen eines öffentlichen Verfahrens ausgeschrieben. Die Umweltbaubegleitung (UBB) begleitet und überwacht die Umweltbelange beim Bau und unterstützt die Bauherrschaft in der rechtskonformen Realisierung des Bauvorhabens. Dabei achtet Sie auf die Einhaltung der umweltrelevanten Gesetze, Verordnungen, Richtlinien, Wegleitungen und Auflagen. Die UBB berät und unterstützt die Beteiligten, beobachtet und beurteilt Umweltprobleme auf der Baustelle und stellt die Umsetzung der Umweltauflagen und Bedingungen aus dem Bewilligungsverfahren sicher. Die UBB berät die Bauherrschaft zudem zu Fragen im Bereich Umwelt. Die UBB aktualisiert regelmässig die Vollzugs- und Auflagenkontrolle (VAK) der Umweltauflagen (s. auch Anhang 03: Auflagen Gesamtbauentscheid zu ÜO ZBBS vom 30.10.2025) und dokumentiert diese in geeigneter Weise (Liste, Datenbank o.ä.). Die UBB führt zudem den Nachweis/Dokumentation über die Erfüllung der Umweltauflagen zuhanden der Behörden und führt eine Pendenzenliste, in welcher die umweltrelevanten Pendenzen aufgeführt sind. Die Pendenzenliste ist, wenn möglich in die Pendenzenliste der Bausitzung zu integrieren. Die UBB überwacht sämtliche Projektbelange und -abläufe mit umweltrelevanten Auswirkungen im Sinne des Vorsorgeprinzips auf die Einhaltung der Umweltvorschriften. Dazu gehören die Ausschreibungen, die Bauplanung, die Planung und Einrichtung der Bauinstallationsplätze, die Transportrouten und -wege, die Materialflüsse, die Bauausführung sowie die Umsetzung der Schutz- und Rekultivierungsmassnahmen. Die UBB ist integral zuständig für sämtliche umweltrelevanten Aspekte, die bei der Realisierung des Vorhabens eine Rolle spielen, die bodenkundliche Baubegleitung (sofern notwendig) inbegriffen. Die UBB stellt primär die sachgerechte Umsetzung der Umweltauflagen aus dem Bewilligungsverfahren sicher und hilft, die Einhaltung der umweltrelevanten Gesetze, Verordnungen, Richtlinien und Wegleitungen zu gewährleisten. Bei der Umsetzung der Umweltauflagen ist der Wortlaut der Bewilligung massgebend. Während der Bauausführung überwacht sie die fachgerechte Umsetzung der im Bewilligungsverfahren, Leistungsverzeichnis und Werkvertrag festgelegten Umweltschutzmassnahmen und überprüft deren Wirkung. Das vorliegende Pflichtenheft basiert auf den bekannten Grundlagen zum Zeitpunkt der Erarbeitung. Sämtliche zum Zeitpunkt der Erarbeitung noch unbekannten Umweltauflagen müssen durch die Auftragnehmerin ebenfalls erfüllt bzw. geprüft werden. Sofern dies nachweislich zu Zusatzleistungen bei der Auftragnehmerin führt, werden diese vergütet und sind durch die Auftragnehmerin zu den Konditionen des Grundauftrags zu erledigen. Die Leistungen sind im Leistungsbeschrieb (Anhang 01) detailliert aufgeführt. Auf Produkte-/Marken-/Design- oder Typenbezeichnungen wird verzichtet. Przedmiot zamówienia obejmuje wykonanie, dostawę i montaż elementów aranżacji wystawy stałej, stanowiących integralną część jednej ekspozycji muzealnej realizowanej na podstawie jednolitej koncepcji scenograficznej, architektonicznej i merytorycznej. Poszczególne elementy ekspozycji pozostają ze sobą w ścisłym związku funkcjonalnym, technicznym i estetycznym, a ich prawidłowe wykonanie wymaga zachowania pełnej kompatybilności rozwiązań materiałowych, konstrukcyjnych, multimedialnych oraz wykończeniowych. Podział zamówienia na części zwiększyłby ryzyko powstania rozbieżności w zakresie jakości wykonania, stosowanych technologii, kolorystyki, sposobu wykończenia oraz integracji poszczególnych elementów ekspozycji, co mogłoby negatywnie wpłynąć na spójność narracyjną i estetyczną wystawy. Zamawiający ocenia jednocześnie, że brak podziału zamówienia na części nie ogranicza konkurencji w sposób nieuzasadniony. Na rynku funkcjonują wyspecjalizowane podmioty posiadające doświadczenie w kompleksowej realizacji wystaw muzealnych i ekspozycji stałych, obejmującej produkcję, dostawę oraz montaż elementów aranżacyjnych. title: Switzerland – Construction project management services – Anlage Schützenmatte, Bern Bollwerk, Umgestaltung Schützenmatte, Gesamtprojektleitung (GPL)
description: Gegenstand der Ausschreibung ist die Vergabe eines Mandats für die Gesamtprojektleitung (GPL) zur Umgestaltung der Schützenmatte über die SIA-Phasen 31 bis 53. Die GPL übernimmt im Auftrag von Tiefbau Stadt Bern die operative Führung des Gesamtprojekts und stellt die zielgerichtete Umsetzung der Projektziele von der Projektierung bis zum Abschluss sicher. Die Aufgabe der GPL umfasst insbesondere die integrale Steuerung eines vielschichtigen, innerstädtischen Transformationsprozesses. Die Schützenmatte ist geprägt durch eine ausserordentlich hohe funktionale, gesellschaftliche und politische Dichte. Als zentral gelegener Stadtraum wirkt sie gleichzeitig als Verkehrsdrehscheibe, Begegnungsort, kultureller Anziehungspunkt sowie als sozialer Brennpunkt. Die GPL stellt sicher, dass die Umgestaltung unter Berücksichtigung dieser komplexen Rahmenbedingungen erfolgt. Dazu gehören insbesondere die vielfältigen Nutzungsansprüche, die hohe öffentliche und politische Aufmerksamkeit sowie die anspruchsvolle Einbettung in bestehende städtische Strukturen und Prozesse. Von zentraler Bedeutung ist zudem die enge Abstimmung mit Drittprojekten. Insbesondere bestehen wesentliche Abhängigkeiten zum Projekt Zukunft Bahnhof Bern (ZBB), welches den Raum während mehrerer Jahre beansprucht und die zeitliche Staffelung der Umgestaltung massgeblich beeinflusst. Ebenso sind Schnittstellen zu weiteren Drittprojekten (u. a. Verkehrsregime, Parkierung, angrenzende Strassenräume wie Hodlerstrasse, Entwicklungen im Umfeld Eilgutareal) kontinuierlich zu koordinieren. Die GPL stellt sicher, dass diese Abhängigkeiten frühzeitig erkannt, abgestimmt und in die Projektsteuerung integriert werden. Die GPL agiert als zentrale Drehscheibe zwischen Bauherrschaft, Verwaltungseinheiten, politischen Gremien, Sicherheitsorganen sowie externen Akteurinnen und Akteuren. Sie gewährleistet eine kohärente Projektführung und stellt sicher, dass die Umgestaltung sowohl fachlich fundiert als auch politisch tragfähig und gesellschaftlich anschlussfähig entwickelt und umgesetzt wird. Die detaillieren geforderten Aufgaben und Leistungen der GPL sind im Leistungsbeschrieb (Anhang 01) genauer erläutert. Die Bauherrschaft geht von einem Umfang von 8 000 Stunden für die Dauer des Mandats aus.
